notes:
1. [拖曳修復] 修正從檔案總管拖曳本機檔案時，因 FileGroupDescriptorW 重疊而誤抓 Ctrl+C 剪貼簿檔案的問題
2. [虛擬檔案隔離] 拖放事件改由 QMimeData 獨立提取虛擬檔案，徹底與系統剪貼簿解耦
3. [穩定性強化] 拖放本機檔案後即時持久化儲存工作階段 (session.json)
notes_en:
1. [Drag & Drop Fix] Fixed an issue where dragging local files from File Explorer could mistakenly grab Ctrl+C clipboard files
2. [Virtual File Isolation] Decoupled drag-and-drop virtual file extraction from the system clipboard
3. [Reliability] Immediately persist session state after dropping local files
